label: Cell faults
subgoals: Name a cell fixed at one value as a stuck-at fault
Name a blocked transition as an up or down transition fault
Add a pause before reading to expose retention faults

label: Coupling faults
subgoals: Identify the aggressor and the victim of a coupling fault
Separate inversion, idempotent and state coupling by their trigger and effect
Sweep addresses in both directions for victims above and below the aggressor

label: Decoder and other faults
subgoals: Recognize one address selecting several cells as a decoder fault
Use physical neighbourhoods for pattern-sensitive faults
Add refresh and retention faults for DRAM
